english.title: Occupier / person concerned in management of smoke-free premises fail to ensure notices are displayed - Health Act 2006
english.standardoffencewording:
On **(..SPECIFY DATE..) at **(..SPECIFY TOWNSHIP..), being

(A)_[the occupier of]_
(B)_[concerned in the management of]_

smoke-free premises, namely **(..SPECIFY THE PREMISES..), failed to make sure that no-smoking signs were displayed in those premises in compliance with the requirements of section 6 of the Health Act 2006
english.legislation: Contrary to section 6(1), (5) and (8) of the Health Act 2006.

english.notes:
(i) Section 6(6) of the Health Act 2006 provides defences to this offence.
(ii) Section 9 of and Schedule 1 to the Act provide for fixed penalties for this offence.
english.standardstatementoffacts:
On **(..SPECIFY DATE..) at **(..SPECIFY TOWNSHIP..) the defendant, being

(A)_[the occupier of]_
(B)_[concerned in the management of]_

smoke-free premises, namely **(..SPECIFY THE PREMISES..), failed to make sure that no-smoking signs were displayed in those premises in compliance with the requirements of section 6 of the Health Act 2006.

other.penalty:
A fine not exceeding a level three on the standard scale.

Fixed penalty notice - £200. Reduced to £150 if paid within 15 days of issue of notice as per para 8 of schedule 1 to the Act.

Time limit for prosecutions:
6 months
